new Assembly.detail: Constructs a new Assembly. Assembly contains either sub-assemblies or a single replicad shape/drawing as .geometry. If other is provided, this will construct a deep copy.

.isLeaf.returns: True if this is Assembly<LeafGeom>. Equivalently, this contains no sub-assemblies.
.isLeaf.detail: Narrows this to type Assembly<LeafGeom> where LeafGeom = replicad.Drawing|replicad.AnyShape

.onLeafs.detail:
Apply function to all leafs in this assembly. Modifies this Assembly
in place. If fn returns null that leaf is dropped from the assembly.
Empty branches are recursively dropped as well.

.is2D.returns: True if this Assembly contains only 2D replicad Drawings.
.is2D.detail: True when this assembly is (or contains, for branches) 2D geometry. As a rule assemblies should not mix 2D and 3D geometries.

.bom.detail: Mutable field containing the bill of materials for this assembly.

.color.detail: Mutable field containing the hex color string of this assembly. Applies to subassemblies unless they overwrite with their own color.

.geometry.detail: Mutable field containing either the list of sub-assemblies if !this.isLeaf(), or a replicad geometry if this.isLeaf().

.plane.detail: Mutable field containing replicad.Plane of this assembly. For 2D geometries this is the plane where they're written.

.tags.detail: Mutable field containing the tags for this assembly. Tags are inherited by sub-assemblies unless they overwrite with their own tags.
